## Checklist

- [ ] Smallest change that fixes or adds the thing described above.
- [ ] Tests added or updated where code changed, and passing
      (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the command for this repo).
- [ ] Every number introduced carries a source and a period, or is
      labelled UNKNOWN / TO VERIFY.
- [ ] No invented features, metrics, or example outputs — examples are
      labelled EXAMPLE unless they are verified demo output already in
      the repo.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or paywalled material.
- [ ] Research/education only — no investment advice, no buy/sell/hold
      recommendation, no guaranteed returns.
